SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE SP. BR. REGISTRY File No 75 C.S.6, Special Branch Station, 4 Date May 12）

REPORT

Subject MR. JOSEPH REHAK - enquiry from the British Consulate-General in
Shanghai.

Made by D.S. Mischenko Forwarded by C.D.I. Tabrum

Mr. Joseph Rehak, born on August 1, 1895 in
Budejovice, Czechoslovakia, married, at present residing
at 70 Verdun Terrace, Avenue du Roi Albert, French
Concession, first came to Shanghai from Vladivostock
in November 1922. He is a restaurateur by profession
and, with the exception of two years absence in
Harbin and periodical visits to Tsingtao, has continually
resided in Shanghai having been engaged in the
restaurant and cabaret business. He is the former owner
of the "Kavkaz" restaurant, which he originally
established at No.172, Range Road then removed to 751,
Dixwell Road and finally to 1236, Rue Lafayette,
French Concession, the manager of the "Canidrome" and
"Majestic" ballrooms and the licence of the "Little
club"; the latter having been sold to Chinese interests
in 1936.

Between the years of 1938 and 1940 he resided
in Harbin, where he managed the "Mars" Cafe, and upon
his return to Shanghai from that city he, in partner-
ship with a Czech named Jan Vybral, opened the "Moravia-
Czech Ham and Sausage Factory", at 3/809 Tongshan Road.
In September 1940, Mr. Joseph Rehak withdrew from the
sausage business and undertook the management of the
"Balalaika" restaurant at 1002, Avenue Joffre, French
Concession, with which concern he is still connected
pending permission to enter Hongkong.

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 特务科 登记室 档案号 75 C.S.6，特务科分站，4 日期 5月12日）

报告

事由：约瑟夫·雷哈克先生（MR. JOSEPH REHAK）——英国驻上海总领事馆的查询。

制作人：D.S. 米申科（Mischenko） 转呈人：C.D.I. 塔布鲁姆（Tabrum）

约瑟夫·雷哈克先生，1895年8月1日出生于捷克斯洛伐克的布杰约维采（Budejovice），已婚，现居住于法租界阿尔贝国王路（Avenue du Roi Albert）凡尔登台70号，于1922年11月首次从符拉迪沃斯托克抵达上海。他的职业是餐馆经营者，除了在哈尔滨缺席两年以及定期前往青岛外，他一直居住在上海，从事餐馆和歌舞厅业务。他是“高加索”（Kavkaz）餐馆的前所有者，该餐馆最初开设于兰路172号，后迁至狄思威路751号，最后迁至法租界霞飞路1236号；他还是“逸园跑狗场”（Canidrome）和“大都会”（Majestic）舞厅的经理，并持有“小俱乐部”（Little club）的执照；后者已于1936年出售给中方利益方。

在1938年至1940年间，他居住在哈尔滨，经营“火星”（Mars）咖啡馆，当他从那座城市返回上海后，他与一位名叫扬·维布拉尔（Jan Vybral）的捷克人合伙，在同山路3/809号开设了“摩拉维亚-捷克火腿香肠厂”。1940年9月，约瑟夫·雷哈克先生退出了香肠业务，着手管理法租界霞飞路1002号的“巴拉莱卡”（Balalaika）餐馆，在获准进入香港之前，他仍与该机构保持关联。

BRITISH CONSULATE GENERAL
REGISTRY
845 SHANGHAI.
3 5 41
5th May, 1941.）

Dear Mr. Sharman,

I have received an application from
Joseph Rehak, a Czechoslovak national, for permission
to proceed to Hongkong to take up employment as the
Restaurant Manager of the "Ritz" in the Colony. The
address given by him in Shanghai is 70 Verdun Terrace,
Avenue du Roi Albert. He holds Czechoslovak passport
No.180037 issued in Shanghai on the 25th April 1932
and valid until the 16th March, 1944.

I should be grateful for any additional
information you can give me regarding this man.

Yours sincerely,
（签名）

V. Sharman, Esquire,
Assistant Commissioner,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
SHANGHAI.

（手写批注：S I / S）

1941年5月5日。）

亲爱的夏曼先生：

我收到了一位捷克斯洛伐克国民约瑟夫·雷哈克的申请，请求允许他前往香港，担任该殖民地“丽兹”餐馆的经理。他在上海提供的地址是阿尔贝国王路凡尔登台70号。他持有1932年4月25日在上海签发的捷克斯洛伐克护照，号码为180037，有效期至1944年3月16日。

如蒙提供关于此人的任何补充信息，我将不胜感激。

您真诚的，
（签名）

V. 夏曼先生，
助理总监，
上海公共租界工部局警务处，
上海。

（手写批注：S I / S）
